         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT LITTLE:    The

        10       invocation today will be given by the Reverend

        11       Peter G. Young, of Blessed Sacrament Church in

        12       Bolton Landing.

        13                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Dear God, as the

        14       snow falls today, we can remember instances

        15       when we needed a little mercy.

        16                  Maybe we needed an extension on a

        17       project; maybe we needed a loan or, as is

        18       often the case, we needed forgiveness from

        19       someone whom we had hurt.

        20                  Remember the sigh of relief when

        21       mercy was granted and the grief and

        22       disappointment when mercy was denied.

        23                  O merciful God, You give us in the

        24       Senate what we need for constant guidance in

        25       Your call.  Grant that we will be able to be



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       generous in mercy toward all New York State

         2       citizens.  May we be known as Senators of

         3       mercy and forgiveness.

         4                  We ask You this in Your name, now

         5       and forever.  Amen.

         6                  ACTING PRESIDENT LITTLE:    Thank

         7       you, Father Young.
